data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's central causal claim—that two critics failing the same artifact 'most economical[ly]' implies a shared structural assumption rather than a shared reasoning error—is an unsupported false dichotomy. The argument rules out (b) shared reasoning error by bare assertion ('rather than'), yet critics can independently arrive at the same *correct* failure verdict through sound reasoning, making both verdicts true positives rather than evidence of any deficiency. SRC_001 conflates 'both failed' (critic error) with 'both produced the same verdict-class' (which includes both being right), then uses that conflation to conclude the test is degenerate—a non sequitur that does not actually sustain a §11.3 flag against the critics.
